data.narrative:
Skydio, a Series F autonomous systems company in the Defense & Security sector, carries a current post-money valuation of $4.4B following $825M+ in total capital raised. The valuation assessment triangulates across a peer universe of 10 comparables: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, applying a 1.3x step-up multiplier typical of Series F to next-stage advancement, implies $5.7B. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Helsing at $18.0B (Series E), Shield AI at $12.7B (Series G), and Flock Safety at $7.5B (Series G)—yields a median valuation of $12.7B. The peer range spans $7.5B to $18.0B, reflecting heterogeneity in stage and market positioning within the defense tech subset.

Triangulation of these two methods produces a median valuation of $9.2B, with a low bound of $4.9B (anchored to stage-progression) and a high bound of $14.6B (anchored to peer-median). The $4.9B–$14.6B range reflects material uncertainty around peer comparability and stage-to-stage value accretion. Key dependencies include the timing and terms of any Series G financing and relative defensibility versus more mature defense contractors in the comparable set.
